'''The Rumbles''' was a location on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that contained several pits.

==History==
The Rumbles was an area in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] that was known for its pits. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Kallie Calwell]], a young girl was still working with her family's [[Dewback/Legends|dewbacks]]. While on a dewback named [[Snit (dewback)|Snit]], the animal stampeded and headed towards the Rumbles. Her mother [[Annileen Calwell]] attempted a rescue, the possibility of a [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] being present clear in their mind. This was when [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], a Jedi Master going under the name Ben, appeared to help the teenager before they crashed. A juvenile sarlacc soon appeared, however and ate Snit.
